_note: WAVE-36 MINING MAP + corpus-wide web-map totals, derived from the wave35-webmap web-only full-capability TITAN run (65 sections, every bucket-A test in each section, no --max-tests sampling). ONE ROW PER SECTION. Definitions: `scored` = tests with scoreEligible:true in the section manifest (the same notion the frozen 3-platform gate calls `measured`); `ineligible` = bucket-A tests excluded before scoring by the extraction wall / not-applicable admission rules; `pass` = browserRef.diffs["web-ref"].wptPass, i.e. ssim>=0.95 OR wptFuzzyMatch, VETOED by semanticPresence, coverage-RATIO (max/min>2) and colorDivergent-with-meanDeltaE>=2.3; `ge95` = raw ssim>=0.95 ignoring the vetoes, so (ge95 - pass) is the veto-only tranche; `meanSsim` = mean over scored cells. WEB ONLY - these numbers are NOT comparable to the 3-platform corpus-v5.x snapshots, which sample 12 tests per section on all three runtimes. Sections sorted alphabetically for diff stability; rank by failing cells is derivable from the `fail` column. miningMap is ranked by (failing cells x plausibility of a single shared fix); the plausibility weight is a judgement call, the cells and metrics are measured.
criterion: ssim>=0.95 OR wptFuzzyMatch, VETOED by semanticPresence + coverage-RATIO (max/min>2) + colorDivergent-with-meanDeltaE>=2.3
sampling: 65 sections x ALL bucket-A tests (no per-section cap)

crossCuttingSignals._note: Corpus-wide signatures that cut across sections. Each is a cheap triage filter over the manifests, not a section.

nearPassFailing.meaning: ssim >= 0.95 already; only a semantic veto (presence / color-mass / coverage-ratio) blocks the pass. The render is structurally close.

colourFlip.meaning: Structure is pixel-identical to the ref but the ink is painted in the test's own FAIL colour (pixelMismatchedPct == ink coverage, labDeltaE p95 == 0, mean >= 2.3). These are single-boolean feature assertions: the WPT test says "green if the feature works" and we paint red. Cheapest class in the corpus - one behaviour flag per family.
colourFlip.exemplar: css-will-change/will-change-stacking-context-opacity-1: ssim 1.0000, pHash 0, edgeSsim 1.0, ink 4.274% both sides, dE mean 3.085 / p95 0.

structureExactInkMass.filter: ssim >= 0.95 AND pHashHamming <= 10 AND (coverageRatio OR presence veto) AND NOT color
structureExactInkMass.meaning: Layout agrees; a discrete small element is missing from (or extra in) the capture. One missing box per family.
structureExactInkMass.exemplar: css-ui/compute-kind-widget-generated: 44 cells all at ssim 0.9782 exactly, capture ink 0.544% vs ref 1.094% (exactly half the widget).

frameHeightDelta._finding: NOT a defect class. capH-refH == +16 on 4937 of 10202 scored cells and is the harness body-margin convention (it appears on 4006 PASSING cells). The honest-frame fold already absorbs it.

miningMap.opportunity: css-images: object-fit contain/cover/fill on replaced elements
miningMap.mechanism: ReplacedElement object-fit scaling + intrinsic sizing
miningMap.evidence: 154 failing of 196 scored (132 object-fit + 22 object-view-box). Perfect control group inside the family: object-fit:none passes 18/32 and scale-down 18/32, while contain 0/32, cover 0/32 and fill 0/32 - every scaling keyword fails, the non-scaling keyword passes. Ink tells the same story: capture 0.94% vs ref 5.98% on the -e/-o/-p (embed/object/picture) variants and 7.26% vs 5.98% on -i (img), i.e. the image is drawn at intrinsic size instead of fitted to the content box. All 40 (-i) variants fail regardless of keyword - a second, nested sub-mechanism. One applier, one control group.

miningMap.opportunity: css-grid: grid-lanes (Grid L3 lanes / masonry track flow)
miningMap.mechanism: grid-lanes track flow: intrinsic sizing, alignment, auto-repeat, baseline, dense packing
miningMap.evidence: The single largest coherent pool in the corpus: 384 failing of 438 scored, 87.7% of the grid-lanes tree. Non-lanes css-grid passes 342/435 (78.6%) - so classic grid works and the lanes algorithm is simply absent. Sub-directories all fail together (intrinsic-sizing 54, alignment 51, tentative/item-placement 35, auto-repeat 34+36, baseline 28, dense-packing 25, grid-placement 14), which is what one missing algorithm looks like. Plausibility is only medium because the fix is a layout algorithm, not a property.

miningMap.opportunity: css-gaps: gap decorations paint (row/column rule)
miningMap.mechanism: gap-decorations painting across grid / subgrid / multicol / flex
miningMap.evidence: 76 failing of 284 scored, uniformly spread over grid (45), multicol (12), subgrid (9) and flex (8) - one paint pass reused by four layout modes. Median ssim 0.879 with only 3 coverage vetoes and 24 colour vetoes, i.e. the boxes are in the right place and the rule ink is missing/miscoloured rather than mislaid. The na tag requires-gap-decorations fires 250x corpus-wide, so the pool grows if the harness admits more of it.

miningMap.opportunity: css-contain: size containment suppressing content contribution
miningMap.mechanism: contain:size / content-visibility intrinsic-size suppression
miningMap.evidence: 104 failing of 280 scored; requires-containment tags 101 of the 104. 81 of them carry a capture/ref height mismatch beyond the benign +16 convention, which is the exact signature of "we let contained content contribute its size and the ref does not". contain-size-* alone is 37 failing / 72 scored with 35 passing siblings, so the harness already renders the surrounding box correctly.

miningMap.opportunity: print medium: page boxes, page margins, paginated fragmentation
miningMap.mechanism: @page box model + print-medium capture (css-page, CSS2/pagination, css-break/table, printing)
miningMap.evidence: 136 failing of 276 scored corpus-wide on *-print tests (css-page 86 of 157, plus CSS2/pagination 17, css-break/table 32, printing 5). 140 already pass, so the print capture path works - what is missing is @page geometry (page-size-010, page-box-008, page-background-005 are the worst cells at ssim 0.14-0.39). requires-print-medium tags 276 cells, requires-fragmentation 2049 - this is the gateway to the largest blocked tier.

miningMap.opportunity: css-shapes: shape-outside float exclusion geometry
miningMap.mechanism: shape-outside exclusion areas for circle / ellipse / inset / shape-box
miningMap.evidence: 68 failing of 101 scored and - uniquely among the big pools - ZERO coverage/presence vetoes and only 4 colour vetoes: every failure is a pure SSIM shortfall, i.e. the right ink in the wrong place. That is a geometry bug, not a delivery gap. Uniform families: shape-box 22, circle 12, inset 10, ellipse 8. requires-float-layout is the top na tag, so the float exclusion path is the shared owner.

miningMap.opportunity: css-ui: kind-of-widget fallback rendering (progress / meter / caret)
miningMap.mechanism: generated widget box for form controls under appearance fallback
miningMap.evidence: The most uniform signature in the corpus: 44 cells at ssim 0.9782 EXACTLY, all vetoed by coverage-ratio and nothing else, capture ink 0.544% vs ref 1.094% on every one - the widget is drawn at exactly half its ink. css-ui otherwise passes 843/926 (91.0%), so this is one generated box in an otherwise healthy section. Pairs with css-forms base-appearance (10 more cells: progress/meter/textarea/input-number *-base-appearance-rendering).

miningMap.opportunity: css-content: quotes / open-quote content strings
miningMap.mechanism: content: open-quote / close-quote with the quotes property and nesting depth
miningMap.evidence: 48 failing of 60 scored - the worst pass rate of any mid-size section (20.0%) - and 36 of the 48 are the quotes-0NN family. 45 of 48 carry the coverage-ratio veto and 41 a height mismatch: the quote glyphs are simply absent, so the lines reflow. requires-bundled-font (16) is the secondary owner for the non-ASCII quote marks. One content-generation path.

miningMap.opportunity: css-overflow: line-clamp block ellipsis
miningMap.mechanism: -webkit-line-clamp / line-clamp:auto block-ellipsis line truncation
miningMap.evidence: 57 failing of 219 scored - and 162 already pass, so the clamp box exists and only the truncation arithmetic is off. Median ssim 0.923 with just 8 coverage and 9 colour vetoes; the failures are line-count-off-by-N, not missing content. Tight family names (line-clamp-auto-0NN, webkit-line-clamp-0NN) make a single fix verifiable across all 57.

miningMap.opportunity: css-viewport: the zoom property
miningMap.mechanism: CSS zoom: used-value scaling of lengths, spacing and stroke
miningMap.evidence: Near-total section failure from one property: 41 failing of 42 scored, ONE pass. Both subtrees are zoom (zoom/ 29, zoom/explicit-inherit 12). Worst cells are border-spacing, border-width, letter-spacing, text-stroke-width - all "a length that must be multiplied by the effective zoom". 34 of 41 carry the coverage-ratio veto, consistent with ink drawn at 1x against a ref drawn at Nx. Smallest surface / largest section-level swing on the map.

miningMap.opportunity: css-highlight-api: ::highlight() painting
miningMap.mechanism: custom highlight pseudo painting over inline runs
miningMap.evidence: 43 failing of 62 scored, 41 vetoed by coverage-ratio, median ssim 0.986 and 34 of them already at ssim >= 0.95 - the text is laid out correctly and the highlight fill is simply not painted (highlight-text: capture ink 0.189% vs ref 0.503%; custom-highlight-container-metrics-001: 0.360% vs 1.041%). The painting/ subtree is 40 of the 43. requires-runtime-selection tags all 43, so admitting a static highlight bake is the whole lane.

miningMap.opportunity: mediaqueries: media-query evaluation at the capture viewport
miningMap.mechanism: aspect-ratio / device-aspect-ratio / calc() / custom-media MQ evaluation
miningMap.evidence: 35 failing of 44 scored with 33 already at ssim >= 0.95 and 17 of them in the colour-flip class (ssim 0.999, pHash 0, ink 5.159% vs 5.188%) - the layout is byte-right and we are painting the fail colour because the query evaluated the wrong way. Zero na tags on the whole section: nothing here is architecturally blocked. aspect-ratio-001..006, device-aspect-ratio-002/003 and mq-calc-001 fail identically, which is one evaluator.

miningMap.opportunity: css-lists: list marker box + counter-style symbol resolution
miningMap.mechanism: ::marker generation, inline/inline-block marker placement, counter-style symbols
miningMap.evidence: 74 failing of 156 scored. Two entangled owners visible in the tags: requires-pseudo-element-rendering (54) for the marker box and the lossy reason counter-style-unsupported (44) for the symbol text. Worst cells are the placement family (inline-list-marker, inline-block-list-marker, inline-list at ssim 0.42-0.50) - marker boxes landing in the wrong inline context. 82 already pass, so the ordinary block marker works.

miningMap.opportunity: css-will-change: will-change creating stacking context / fixed-pos containing block
miningMap.mechanism: will-change as a stacking-context and containing-block trigger
miningMap.evidence: 32 failing of 43 scored, 19 of them pure colour-flips: will-change-stacking-context-{opacity,filter,mask,clip-path,mix-blend-mode,perspective,position,isolation,offset-path,backdrop-filter}-1 all score ssim 1.0000 with pHash 0 and identical 4.274% ink on both sides - pixel-perfect structure, fail-colour ink. The second family (will-change-fixpos-cb-*) is the containing-block half. Two boolean predicates in one property.

miningMap.opportunity: css-shadow: flattened shadow tree + :host/::slotted selector matching
miningMap.mechanism: shadow-root flattening, slot assignment, :host()/::slotted()/:has(::slotted) matching
miningMap.evidence: 56 failing of 105 scored but 50 of the 56 are already at ssim >= 0.95 and 19 are colour-flips (has-slotted-001/003, host-has-001/002, host-descendant-003, css-scoping-shadow-nested-slot-display-override) - the flattened tree renders, the selectors do not match. requires-shadow-dom tags 55 of 56, so this needs an architectural decision first; once taken, the per-test work is selector matching, not layout.

miningMap.opportunity: css-masking: clip-path basic shapes and document-element clipping
miningMap.mechanism: clip-path circle/ellipse/inset/rect geometry + clip on the document element
miningMap.evidence: 39 failing of 126 scored with 87 passing - the mask/clip plumbing works and specific shape geometry does not. clip-path/ is 25 of the 39, and the worst cells are the reference-box keywords (clip-path-circle-farthest-corner / closest-corner, clip-path-rect-001/002) plus clip-path-document-element - i.e. radius resolution against the reference box. Note 51 of 177 tests are ineligible here, the highest exclusion rate of any large section.

miningMap.opportunity: css-images: image-set() never resolves to a paintable image
miningMap.mechanism: image-set() resolution for background-image and content
miningMap.evidence: 28 failing of 36 scored, and every single one measures capture ink 0.000% against ref 4.274% - image-set() paints NOTHING, in a tight ssim band of 0.944-0.971. Both the presence AND coverage-ratio vetoes fire on all 28. The gradient variants (image-set-{conic,radial,repeating-linear}-gradient-rendering) prove the underlying gradient painters work when reached directly. One resolution step in one function.

miningMap.opportunity: css-writing-modes: orthogonal flows and logical/physical mapping
miningMap.mechanism: orthogonal flow sizing + vertical writing-mode logical-to-physical mapping
miningMap.evidence: 74 failing of 136 scored, requires-orthogonal-flow the dominant tag. That tag fires on 638 scored cells corpus-wide (279 failing) - css-grid, css-flexbox, css-ruby, css-text-decor and css-align all inherit from the same missing capability, so the blast radius is ~4x the section. Worst cells (logical-physical-mapping-001, direction-upright-001/002, the vrl/slr float families at ssim 0.54-0.59) point at the axis-swap itself.

miningMap.opportunity: css-view-transitions: snapshot pseudo tree (large pool, architecture-blocked)
miningMap.mechanism: ::view-transition pseudo tree + captured old/new snapshots
miningMap.evidence: Listed for size, not for cheapness: 142 failing of 192 scored, the 3rd largest pool. But requires-view-transitions tags all 142, requires-animation-runtime 117 and requires-document-tree 113 - it needs a live transition runtime the static IR does not model. 32 cells are already near-pass, so a partial static bake of the snapshot pseudo tree could harvest a slice without the runtime. Do not schedule this ahead of the single-property lanes above.

miningMap.opportunity: css-images: gradient hue interpolation in polar colour spaces
miningMap.mechanism: lch/oklch hue interpolation, powerless/missing components, none-interpolation
miningMap.evidence: 30 failing of 76 scored, 20 vetoed on colour mass - structure agrees, the ramp is wrong. The failing names name the mechanism exactly: gradient-{increasing,decreasing}-hue-lch, gradient-hue-direction, gradient-powerless-hue-{lch,oklch}, gradient-analogous-missing-components-004, gradient-single-stop-none-interpolation. 46 gradients already pass, so this is the CSS Color 4 interpolation rules, not the painter.

reproduce: per section: section-runner.sh <section> --web-only --run-id wave35-webmap --foreground; then read tools/titan/runs/wave35-webmap/sections/<section>/manifest.json -> wpt.results[*].browserRef.diffs["web-ref"].
